definition: Inside a place, or during a period of time.
exampleSentence: My keys are in the top drawer of my desk.

definition: Touching the top of something.
exampleSentence: Please put the books on the table near the window.

definition: Used for an exact place or time.
exampleSentence: The meeting starts at nine, so please do not be late.

definition: Near, done by someone, or not later than.
exampleSentence: Please send me the final report by Friday afternoon.

definition: Used to show purpose or who receives something.
exampleSentence: I bought these beautiful flowers for my mother's birthday party.

definition: Together with someone or something.
exampleSentence: I went to the cinema with my best friend last night.

definition: Showing where something starts or comes from.
exampleSentence: This coffee comes from a small farm in Colombia.

definition: Showing direction or a destination.
exampleSentence: We drove to the airport early this morning.

definition: Showing belonging, or a part of something.
exampleSentence: The roof of the old house needs repairs.

definition: On the subject of.
exampleSentence: We watched a documentary about the history of the internet.

definition: Below something.
exampleSentence: The cat is sleeping under the kitchen table again.

definition: Above, or across from one side to the other.
exampleSentence: A small plane flew over our house this morning.

definition: Higher than something.
exampleSentence: There is a beautiful painting above the fireplace in the living room.

definition: Lower than something.
exampleSentence: Please write your name below the line at the bottom.

definition: In the space that separates two things.
exampleSentence: The bank is between the post office and the bakery.

definition: Surrounded by, or part of, a group.
exampleSentence: She was the youngest among all the students in her class.

definition: At the back of something.
exampleSentence: You can find the car park behind the big shopping center.

definition: Facing or before something.
exampleSentence: There is a bus stop right in front of my building.

definition: Very close to; beside.
exampleSentence: Can I sit next to you during the presentation?

definition: Not far from.
exampleSentence: We live near a beautiful park with a small lake.

definition: In the inner part of something.
exampleSentence: Please wait inside the building until the rain stops.

definition: Not inside a building or place.
exampleSentence: The children are playing outside the school in the sun.

definition: From one side to the other side of something.
exampleSentence: The train goes through a long tunnel under the mountains.

definition: From one side to the other of a flat area.
exampleSentence: We walked across the bridge to the old part of town.

definition: Following the length of something.
exampleSentence: We took a long walk along the beach at sunset.

definition: On every side of something, or in a circle.
exampleSentence: The children sat around the fire and sang songs.

definition: Moving to the inside of something.
exampleSentence: She poured the hot coffee into a large mug.

definition: Moving to a position on top of something.
exampleSentence: The cat jumped onto the kitchen counter again.

definition: Within a period of time.
exampleSentence: Please turn off your phone during the movie.

definition: Earlier than.
exampleSentence: Always wash your hands with soap before every meal you eat.

definition: Later than.
exampleSentence: We went for a walk after dinner last night.

definition: Not having or using something.
exampleSentence: I cannot start my day without a cup of coffee.

definition: Opposing someone, or touching something for support.
exampleSentence: Our team played against the champions last weekend.

definition: In the direction of.
exampleSentence: The dog ran towards me when I opened the gate.

definition: Going beyond a place, or later than a time.
exampleSentence: It is already half past seven, and dinner is not ready.

definition: Next to.
exampleSentence: She sat beside her grandmother at the wedding dinner.

definition: Similar to.
exampleSentence: Everyone says my little brother looks just like our father.

definition: Not including.
exampleSentence: The shop is open every day except Sunday.

definition: Inside a period of time or a limit.
exampleSentence: You will receive the package within three working days.

definition: On the far side of something, or more than.
exampleSentence: There is a small village just beyond those hills.
